about: Darren W. Penn is an attorney who represents clients in the Atlanta, Georgia area. Darren Penn is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2008 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Darren Penn chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Georgia School of Law and graduated in 1994. Darren Penn passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1994.
He represents clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues in Georgia. He also represents clients with Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff and Business Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Darren Penn has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
